# rev

Reverse the bytes in each ASCII record through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
printf 'hello\n' | moonx cli/rev

moonx cli/rev input.txt
```

Read files or stdin, reverse each record and write it with its original record separator.

## Notes

Workspace builds use the MoonBit 2026-11-26 toolchain.

- Non-ASCII input is rejected. Memory use grows with the longest record; NUL-delimited records are supported.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
